title: Report select control
responsibility: Provides a labeled native selection control with shared report styling.

inputs.name: Select.value
inputs.description: Selected native select value, bindable in both directions through the wrapper. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: Select.label
inputs.description: Required accessible label passed to the native select as its aria-label.

inputs.name: Select.id
inputs.description: Optional id passed to the native select when supplied; the component does not transform or validate it.

inputs.name: Select.name
inputs.description: Optional native form field name passed through when supplied; the component does not transform it.

inputs.name: Select.required
inputs.description: Optional required flag passed to the native select. When omitted, the component forwards undefined and does not set the required attribute.

inputs.name: Select.disabled
inputs.description: Controls the native disabled state and the outer disabled styling. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: Select.compact
inputs.description: Enables compact styling for the native select. Its height returns to 44 pixels on coarse-pointer devices.

inputs.name: Select.expanded
inputs.description: Controls the in-page listbox presentation. When true, the native select size is measured from its options and optgroups and clamped to 2–8 rows; the caret and display overlay are hidden.

inputs.name: Select.display
inputs.description: Optional text overlaid on the closed select when not expanded; strings longer than 16 characters are shortened to the first and last six characters with an ellipsis. When title is omitted, this value also supplies the native title.

inputs.name: Select.title
inputs.description: Optional native title text. When omitted, the display value is used; if both are undefined, the native title is omitted.

inputs.name: Select.children
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet rendered inside the native select to provide its child markup, typically option elements.

outputs.name: Select
outputs.description: Renders a styled hx-span containing a native hx-select with the required label as aria-label, the child snippet, and a decorative caret. In expanded mode the select receives a measured size clamped to 2–8 rows and the caret and display overlay are hidden; otherwise, a supplied display value appears in an aria-hidden overlay.

errors.name: Caller content or binding error
errors.description: A synchronous exception from caller-provided children or a caller-side value binding propagates because this component does not catch it.
